input.summary: Ported fuzz.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/fuzz.dp.cpp. The file has no dpct:: helpers, DPCT_* macros, or dpct includes, and it compiles with icpx -fsycl with 0 warnings (add_dpct_include=false). Design: default_selector_v queue with enable_profiling; USM device buffers (malloc_device/memcpy/free); a 1-D parallel_for over range<1>(n) computing norm * sycl::tanh(drive * in[i]); kernel_ms from event profiling start/end; same CLI, WAV I/O via wav.hpp, and error exit codes as the original. Not verified numerically: I did not run the binary against the CUDA reference, so the -96 dBFS null test is still unchecked.
